blockersFixed.description: Public generator API ({ seed }) and mulberry32 silently coerced NaN, Infinity, non-numeric, and undefined seeds into a deterministic 0 seed via bitwise truncation.
blockersFixed.fix: Added finite-number validation to mulberry32 that throws TypeError for non-number or non-finite seeds. All T17 generators inherit this validation because they call mulberry32(seed).
blockersFixed.verification: New unit tests in prng.test.ts assert rejection of NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, string, object, and undefined seeds.

blockersFixed.description: randNonZero helpers and quadratic-factoring case-selection loops (caseMonicPositive, caseMonicBothNegative) used unbounded do-while/while loops that could theoretically iterate forever on a broken PRNG.
blockersFixed.fix: Added bounded safety counters (100 for randNonZero, 20 for case selection) with explicit errors or deterministic cyclic fallbacks so every loop has a hard upper bound.
blockersFixed.verification: Full math-content vitest suite still passes (522/522); no new infinite-iteration paths introduced.

observations.description: Fraction arithmetic could overflow JS safe integers if used with very large numerators/denominators. This is not reachable through the bounded generator inputs (small integer coefficients), but consumers using Fraction directly with huge values should be aware.
observations.recommendation: Document the intended range or add an overflow guard if Fraction is promoted to a general-purpose public utility beyond generator use.

observations.description: Root-level `npx tsc --noEmit` passes. Package-level `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/math-content/tsconfig.json` still reports pre-existing TS2591/TS2503 errors for missing node/React ambient types in non-T17 files (exports.test.ts, no-measure-coupling.guard.test.ts, im1 test scaffolding, coverage-matrix.ts, schemas/types.ts). These pre-date T17 and are not introduced by the security fixes.

noFindings.result: No eval, new Function, or other dynamic code execution found in T17 source or tests.
No __proto__/constructor/prototype assignment, no dynamic property access from untrusted input, no object spread of unvalidated objects.
No hardcoded secrets, API keys, passwords, or tokens introduced in T17 files.
No new runtime dependencies introduced by T17.
No exported methods named after trusted built-ins in a way that could confuse consumers. Fraction.valueOf is the standard coercion hook.
Production T17 code does not use regex on untrusted input. Test-only regex parsers are bounded by small generated strings.
Implementation matches the spec verbatim, uses Math.imul for 32-bit signed multiplication and >>> 0 for unsigned coercion, so it is deterministic across JS engines.

A2_consentBlindPublishGate.reason: T17 is a pure math-content generator package. There are no draft/published status transitions, consent artifacts, or named subject publishing tests.

A6_registryOverstatement.reason: measure/tracks.md entry for T17 states 'Next actionable T## track' and links to the track directory; it does not claim any security state is 'resolved'.

fixesCommitted.message: security(math-content): validate mulberry32 seed is a finite number
security(math-content): bound randNonZero and case-selection loops

typecheck.note: Root-level check passes. Package-level math-content check has pre-existing ambient-type errors unrelated to T17.

recommendation: ACCEPT with the committed security fixes. The T17 algebra generators now enforce finite numeric seeds and guarantee bounded iteration. No further security blockers remain in scope. The pre-existing package-level TypeScript ambient-type errors should be handled under the existing CI-typecheck remediation track or a follow-up chore; they are outside T17's security surface.
